## Motivation

A qwen4_exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) decode step crosses 96 gated hyper-connection boundaries. On ROCm each runs combine, per-branch RMSNorm and the low-rank mix (two GEMMs, 10240 x 320 and 320 x 10240) as 4-6 kernels: 46-56 µs per boundary on MI355X at 16-64 rows, 4.4-5.4 ms per step. With AITER's FlyDSL `hc_mix` (#41880) for the mix, the boundary takes 19-34 µs at 16-64 rows; the combine and the norm stay separate.

Related:
- #41880 (merged) runs AITER's FlyDSL `hc_mix` for the mix at 1-128 rows on gfx950, when the installed AITER has `aiter/ops/flydsl/hc_mix.py` (ROCm/aiter#5993). The AITER commit in `docker/rocm.Dockerfile` (285579b62) does not have it yet.
- #40552 reworks this boundary for SM100.

## Modifications

- `kernels/ops/gemm/hc_seam.py`: the boundary as three Triton launches (down projection with the combine fused in; reduction with norm, SiLU and the next gate; up projection with the gated mean), plus a combine-only kernel. Deterministic (no atomics or grid barriers), CUDA-graph safe; rows above 64 run in 64-row tiles.
- `GatedResidual.mix()` runs the seam for batches in the row window, decode or extend, and marks its result. The following `combine()` then runs only the combine kernel, and `seam_combine_mix()` fuses an attention write-back with the next FFN read (wired through `GatedResidualState` and `qwen4_exp.py`).
- The seam is checked before #41880's FlyDSL path. When enabled it also takes the rows FlyDSL would run. Per layer (one separate and one fused boundary) it took 9-43 % less time than FlyDSL at 1-128 rows (below).
- Opt-in, gfx950 (MI355X) only: `SGLANG_ENABLE_QWEN4_HC_SEAM=1`. Row window `SGLANG_QWEN4_HC_SEAM_MIN_ROWS` / `_MAX_ROWS` (default 1 / 193, kernel limit 256).
- Everything else keeps the existing path: other batch sizes, MTP draft layers (left for a follow-up), forwards traced by torch.compile, other GPUs.
- Numerics: the combined residual is bitwise the same as stock. The norm and mix sum in a different fp32 order, and the up-projection output is not rounded to bf16 (as in `fused_hc_mix`).
- New `benchmark/kernels/bench_hc_seam.py` and `test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_hc_seam.py` (MI35x CI suite).

## Accuracy Tests

This PR's kernel and stock vs an fp64 evaluation of the same formula, on `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm724-mi35x-20261030` with this PR's tree: 12 row counts from 1 to 193; separate, fused and mix-only calls; synthetic and checkpoint weights (144 cases).
- Combined residual: bitwise equal.
- Mixed output: relative L2 error at most 2.84e-3 (stock: 2.90e-3).
- Next gate: max abs error at most 2.04e-4.
  - At each row count, the worst case equals stock's; at 1 row it is lower.
  - Per case it is above stock's in 15 of 144, by at most 1.2e-7.

End to end, TP2 MI355X: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm724-mi35x-20261030` vs the same image with only this PR applied, `SGLANG_ENABLE_QWEN4_HC_SEAM=1` in both (default 1-193 rows; the baseline ignores it). GSM8K 5-shot chat, lm-eval 0.4.13, thinking off, temperature 0, all 1319 questions, strict-match:

| Concurrency | Baseline | This PR | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | 96.51 % | 96.29 % | -0.23 pp (SE 0.39) |
| 64 | 96.13 % | 96.74 % | +0.61 pp (SE 0.39) |

MMMU, on an earlier build that also carried other unmerged qwen4_exp changes, seam at 17-193 rows: 66.56 % → 67.22 %, +0.67 pp (SE 0.82).

SE in percentage points (GSM8K paired by question). Differences within about 2 SE are run-to-run variation.

| Rows | Stock | Stock, FlyDSL mix | Separate | Fused | Separate / stock | Separate / FlyDSL mix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 42.93 | 16.14 | 15.81 | 13.40 | 0.37 | 0.98 |
| 4 | 50.48 | 17.17 | 15.96 | 13.89 | 0.32 | 0.93 |
| 8 | 50.97 | 17.73 | 16.29 | 14.11 | 0.32 | 0.92 |
| 16 | 51.78 | 19.05 | 16.55 | 14.54 | 0.32 | 0.87 |
| 17 | 45.73 | 20.91 | 19.86 | 18.10 | 0.43 | 0.95 |
| 32 | 46.48 | 22.27 | 21.12 | 19.39 | 0.45 | 0.95 |
| 64 | 55.73 | 34.09 | 22.49 | 20.79 | 0.40 | 0.66 |
| 65 | 55.87 | 36.00 | 24.30 | 22.63 | 0.43 | 0.67 |
| 96 | 56.87 | 40.81 | 27.30 | 24.67 | 0.48 | 0.67 |
| 128 | 58.16 | 46.44 | 27.73 | 24.86 | 0.48 | 0.60 |
| 193 | 60.53 | 60.59 | 36.69 | 33.88 | 0.61 | 0.61 |

- Separate: the combine kernel, then the seam. Fused: the combine inside the seam, used where an attention write-back meets the FFN read. Each layer runs one of each.
- Run-to-run spread ≤ 2.5 %, except "Stock, FlyDSL mix" at 16 and 17 rows (3.9 % and 3.6 %).
- `test_hc_seam.py` (13 tests) and `test_hc_mix_flydsl.py` (5 tests) pass on the same setup.
- Timed: decode batches under CUDA graphs. Extend batches of 1-193 tokens also take the seam; this table does not time them.

End to end, same setup as the GSM8K run: `sglang.bench_serving`, 4 runs per arm and workload (server lifetimes baseline, PR, PR, baseline; two passes each). The image's AITER has no FlyDSL `hc_mix`, so this baseline runs the non-FlyDSL mix; the comparison with #41880's FlyDSL path follows.

| random 1024 in / 512 out, c16 | 950.1 → 1206.5 | +27.0 % (1.1) | 16.39 → 12.97 | -20.9 % (0.4) | 13.31 → 9.74 | -26.8 % (0.1) |
| random 1024 in / 512 out, c32 | 1454.0 → 1666.0 | +14.6 % (3.4) | 20.97 → 18.83 | -10.2 % (1.9) | 14.90 → 12.27 | -17.7 % (0.2) |
| random 1024 in / 512 out, c64 | 2038.6 → 2276.2 | +11.7 % (3.6) | 31.27 → 28.21 | -9.8 % (3.6) | 18.83 → 15.38 | -18.3 % (0.3) |
| image 512x512, 1024 in / 128 out, c32 | 805.9 → 859.1 | +6.6 % (3.1) | 37.33 → 34.94 | -6.4 % (3.1) | 14.20 → 11.48 | -19.2 % (0.9) |
| image 512x512, 1024 in / 128 out, c64 | 1004.9 → 1120.8 | +11.5 % (2.4) | 61.35 → 54.72 | -10.8 % (2.1) | 17.40 → 14.04 | -19.3 % (0.8) |

- Values are baseline → this PR, means over the 4 runs of each run's output tok/s, median TPOT and median ITL. SE from each arm's run-to-run spread; every change is beyond 2 SE. Output tok/s geometric mean +18.3 %.
- Median ITL is the typical gap between two output tokens, which at full concurrency is one decode step. It fell by 3.51 / 3.57 / 2.63 / 3.45 ms at c4 / c16 / c32 / c64 (image: 2.72 / 3.35 ms). The kernel table predicts 3.41 / 3.48 / 2.52 / 3.27 ms: 48 layers × (2 × stock − separate − fused) at the concurrency's row count.
- Output tok/s was the metric chosen before the run; TPOT and ITL come from the same results.

Against #41880's FlyDSL `hc_mix`, the setup is the following:
- One image: the same nightly with this PR, plus AITER main's `hc_mix.py` and FlyDSL 0.4.1 as in the kernel table.
- `SGLANG_ENABLE_QWEN4_HC_SEAM` unset (FlyDSL mix) or `1` (this PR).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| random 1024 in / 512 out, c64 | 2335.2 → 2408.4 | +3.1 % (1.5) | 27.62 → 26.58 | -3.8 % (1.3) | 16.53 → 15.41 | -6.8 % (0.1) |

+"""Per-boundary time of the qwen4_exp HC boundary: stock GatedResidual (combine, then norm + mix) vs the fused seam.
+
+Each arm runs BOUNDARIES boundaries with distinct weights inside one CUDA graph; the median replay is divided by
+BOUNDARIES. inter = hc_gated_combine + mix-only seam (EP1: every boundary); intra = combine fused into the seam.
+
+    python benchmark/kernels/bench_hc_seam.py --rows 16,32,64,128,193
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import statistics
+
+import torch
+
+import sglang.srt.layers.hyperconnection as hcm
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.hc_seam import HC, HS, LOWRANK, hc_gated_combine, hc_seam
+from sglang.srt.layers.hyperconnection import GatedResidual, HyperConnectionConfig
+
+D = HC * HS
+EPS = 1e-6
+
+
+def _module(gen):
+    cfg = HyperConnectionConfig(
+        hc_count=HC,
+        hidden_size=HS,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        hc_lowrank=LOWRANK,
+        rms_norm_eps=EPS,
+        hc_per_branch_norm=True,
+    )
+    m = GatedResidual(cfg).cuda()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for p, std in (
+            (m.hc_norm.weight, 0.1),
+            (m.input_mix_weight_down.weight, 0.04),
+            (m.input_mix_weight_up.weight, 0.1),
+            (m.block_inject_weight.weight, 0.04),
+        ):
+            p.copy_(torch.randn(p.shape, generator=gen, device="cuda") * std)
+    return m
+
+
+def _graph_us(fn, replays):
+    s = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    s.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(s):
+        fn()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(s)
+    g = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(g):
+        fn()
+    for _ in range(20):
+        g.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    times = []
+    for _ in range(replays):
+        a, b = (
+            torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+            torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
+        )
+        a.record()
+        g.replay()
+        b.record()
+        b.synchronize()
+        times.append(a.elapsed_time(b) * 1e3)
+    return statistics.median(times)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--rows", default="16,32,64,128,193")
+    ap.add_argument("--boundaries", type=int, default=24)
+    ap.add_argument("--replays", type=int, default=200)
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    rows_list = [int(x) for x in args.rows.split(",")]
+    hcm._HC_SEAM = False  # the stock arm, whatever SGLANG_ENABLE_QWEN4_HC_SEAM says
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)  # as the model loader builds the layers
+    mods = [(_module(gen), _module(gen)) for _ in range(args.boundaries)]
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)
+
+    def acts(rows):
+        y = torch.randn(rows, HS, generator=gen, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+        r = (torch.randn(rows, D, generator=gen, device="cuda") * 3).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        return y, r
+
+    # Compile the stock mix as a server meets widths: a prefill size, then decode sizes large to small.
+    for rows in [512] + sorted(rows_list, reverse=True):
+        y, r = acts(rows)
+        prev, cur = mods[0]
+        cur.mix(prev.combine(y, prev.mix(r)[1]))
+
+    print(
+        f"{'rows':>5} {'stock us':>9} {'inter us':>9} {'intra us':>9} {'inter/stock':>12}"
+    )
+    for rows in rows_list:
+        inputs = []
+        for prev, cur in mods:
+            y, r = acts(rows)
+            _, res = prev.mix(r)
+            gate = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(
+                res[1].float() @ prev.block_inject_weight.weight.float().t() / HC
+            )
+            inputs.append((y, res, gate.contiguous()))
+        weights = [
+            (
+                cur.hc_norm.weight,
+                cur.input_mix_weight_down.weight,
+                cur.input_mix_weight_up.weight,
+                cur.block_inject_weight.weight,
+                EPS,
+            )
+            for _, cur in mods
+        ]
+
+        def stock():
+            for (prev, cur), (y, res, _) in zip(mods, inputs):
+                cur.mix(prev.combine(y, res))
+
+        def inter():
+            for w, (y, res, gate) in zip(weights, inputs):
+                hc_seam(None, hc_gated_combine(y, res[0], gate), None, *w)
+
+        def intra():
+            for w, (y, res, gate) in zip(weights, inputs):
+                hc_seam(y, res[0], gate, *w)
+
+        t = [
+            _graph_us(f, args.replays) / args.boundaries for f in (stock, inter, intra)
+        ]
+        print(f"{rows:>5} {t[0]:>9.2f} {t[1]:>9.2f} {t[2]:>9.2f} {t[1] / t[0]:>12.3f}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Fused decode HC seam for qwen4_exp gated hyper-connections (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: HC 4 x H 2560, low rank 320).
+
+One seam is the work between the TP all-reduce of a block output ``y`` and the next block's GEMM input:
+
+    a     = gate of the previous stage, 2 * sigmoid(xn_prev . W_inject_prev / HC)          (fp32 [M, HC])
+    R'    = bf16(R + a[c] * y)                                       (combine; skipped for a mix-only seam)
+    xn    = bf16(R' * rsqrt(mean_branch(R'^2) + eps) * (1 + w_norm))                       (per-branch norm)
+    t     = bf16(silu(xn . W_down^T / HC))                                                  ([M, 320])
+    mixed = bf16(mean_c(sigmoid(t . W_up[c]^T) * xn[c]))                                   ([M, H])
+    a'    = 2 * sigmoid(xn . W_inject^T / HC)                         (gate the next combine will use)
+
+Three launches, no atomics and no inter-CTA waits (deterministic, CUDA-graph safe):
+  K_a  split-K over the 10240-wide row: combine, branch sum of squares, and the norm-deferred down-projection
+       partials (the per-branch rsqrt is a scalar per (row, branch), so it is applied after the dot).
+  K_f  fixed-order (tree) reduction of the partials: rsqrt and t; plus one program per (row, branch) that computes
+       that entry of a' from the exact bf16 xn, as the stock combine does.
+  K_b  up projection of all HC branches in one dot pair, sigmoid, exact bf16 xn, gated mean.
+``hc_gated_combine`` (K_c) is the combine alone, for a boundary whose mix runs later.
+
+K_a and K_b tile rows on their slowest grid axis: up to _ROW_TILE rows a call runs one BM = next_pow2(rows) tile,
+above that tiles of _ROW_TILE rows, so every row goes through the arithmetic of a single-tile call.
+The per-device workspace is reused by every seam; seams on one stream run in order, so it needs no clearing.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+HC = 4
+HS = 2560
+LOWRANK = 320
+MAX_ROWS = 256  # rows per call (workspace size)
+_ROW_TILE = 64
+
+# Fixed launch configuration, chosen by a tile sweep on gfx950. K_f and K_b read each operand in a few wide loads;
+# chains of small loads measured slower.
+KA_KB = 256  # row chunk per K_a program (divides HS)
+KA_BK = 64
+KA_BN = 64
+KA_WARPS = 4
+KF_BM = 8
+KF_BL = 16
+KF_BKG = 512
+KB_BJ = 16
+KB_LA = 256  # LOWRANK = KB_LA + (LOWRANK - KB_LA); both parts powers of two
+KB_WARPS = 4
+KC_BLOCK = 2048
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_combine_apply_kernel(
+    y_ptr,
+    r_ptr,
+    a_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    total,
+    HC_: tl.constexpr,
+    HS_: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < total
+    D: tl.constexpr = HC_ * HS_
+    m = offs // D
+    k = offs % D
+    c = k // HS_
+    i = k % HS_
+    r = tl.load(r_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = tl.load(y_ptr + m * HS_ + i, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + m * HC_ + c, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, tl.fma(a, y, r).to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_seam_down_kernel(
+    y_ptr,
+    r_ptr,
+    a_ptr,
+    rout_ptr,
+    wn_ptr,
+    wd_ptr,
+    p_ptr,
+    ss_ptr,
+    M,
+    HC_: tl.constexpr,
+    HS_: tl.constexpr,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    KB: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+    BN: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_COMBINE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    D: tl.constexpr = HC_ * HS_
+    pid_k = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(1)
+    k_base = pid_k * KB
+    c = k_base // HS_
+    offs_m = tl.program_id(2) * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    offs_n = pid_n * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)
+    mask_n = offs_n < L
+    first_n = pid_n == 0
+    if HAS_COMBINE:
+        a_m = tl.load(a_ptr + offs_m * HC_ + c, mask=mask_m, other=0.0)
+
+    acc = tl.zeros((BM, BN), dtype=tl.float32)
+    ss = tl.zeros((BM,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    for kk in range(0, KB, BK):
+        k = k_base + kk + tl.arange(0, BK)
+        r = tl.load(
+            r_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * D + k[None, :], mask=mask_m[:, None], other=0.0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        if HAS_COMBINE:
+            y = tl.load(
+                y_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * HS_ + (k - c * HS_)[None, :],
+                mask=mask_m[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            rn = tl.fma(a_m[:, None], y, r).to(rout_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+            tl.store(
+                rout_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * D + k[None, :],
+                rn,
+                mask=mask_m[:, None] & first_n,
+            )
+            r = rn.to(tl.float32)
+        ss += tl.sum(r * r, axis=1)
+        wn = tl.load(wn_ptr + k).to(tl.float32)
+        z = (r * (1.0 + wn)[None, :]).to(wd_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+        wd = tl.load(
+            wd_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * D + k[None, :], mask=mask_n[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        acc = tl.dot(z, tl.trans(wd), acc)
+
+    tl.store(
+        p_ptr + pid_k * M * L + offs_m[:, None] * L + offs_n[None, :],
+        acc,
+        mask=mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :],
+    )
+    tl.store(ss_ptr + pid_k * M + offs_m, ss, mask=mask_m & first_n)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_seam_reduce_kernel(
+    p_ptr,
+    ss_ptr,
+    r_ptr,
+    wn_ptr,
+    wi_ptr,
+    t_ptr,
+    rs_ptr,
+    aout_ptr,
+    M,
+    eps,
+    HC_: tl.constexpr,
+    HS_: tl.constexpr,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    KB: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    BL: tl.constexpr,
+    BKG: tl.constexpr,
+    NKP: tl.constexpr,
+    NQP: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Programs (pid_m, pid_l < NLT) reduce the down-projection partials of a [BM, BL] tile; programs with
+    pid_l >= NLT (gate grid only) each compute one of a row's next combine gates from the exact bf16 xn.
+    Each branch's split-K chunks are read in one masked load and summed as a tree, so a program issues a few
+    independent loads instead of a chain of small ones."""
+    D: tl.constexpr = HC_ * HS_
+    NKC_B: tl.constexpr = HS_ // KB  # split-K chunks per branch (<= NKP)
+    NQ: tl.constexpr = HS_ // BKG  # gate chunks per branch (<= NQP)
+    NLT: tl.constexpr = (L + BL - 1) // BL
+    pid_m = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_l = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_j = tl.arange(0, NKP)
+    mask_j = offs_j < NKC_B
+    if pid_l < NLT:
+        offs_m = pid_m * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+        mask_m = offs_m < M
+        offs_l = pid_l * BL + tl.arange(0, BL)
+        mask_l = offs_l < L
+        first_l = pid_l == 0
+        t_raw = tl.zeros((BM, BL), dtype=tl.float32)
+        for c in tl.static_range(HC_):
+            kc = c * NKC_B + offs_j
+            ssb = tl.sum(
+                tl.load(
+                    ss_ptr + kc[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :],
+                    mask=mask_j[:, None] & mask_m[None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                ),
+                axis=0,
+            )
+            ub = tl.sum(
+                tl.load(
+                    p_ptr
+                    + kc[:, None, None] * (M * L)
+                    + offs_m[None, :, None] * L
+                    + offs_l[None, None, :],
+                    mask=mask_j[:, None, None]
+                    & mask_m[None, :, None]
+                    & mask_l[None, None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                ),
+                axis=0,
+            )
+            rs = tl.math.rsqrt(ssb / HS_ + eps)
+            tl.store(rs_ptr + offs_m * HC_ + c, rs, mask=mask_m & first_l)
+            t_raw += rs[:, None] * ub
+        a = t_raw * (1.0 / HC_)
+        t = a * tl.sigmoid(a)
+        tl.store(
+            t_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * L + offs_l[None, :],
+            t.to(t_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=mask_m[:, None] & mask_l[None, :],
+        )
+    else:
+        # One program per (row, output gate): the row's exact bf16 xn dotted with one W_inject row.
+        q = pid_l - NLT
+        m = pid_m * BM + q // HC_
+        cp = q % HC_
+        if m < M:
+            offs_q = tl.arange(0, NQP)
+            mask_q = offs_q < NQ
+            offs_k = tl.arange(0, BKG)
+            accv = tl.zeros((NQP, BKG), dtype=tl.float32)
+            for c in tl.static_range(HC_):
+                ssb = tl.sum(
+                    tl.load(
+                        ss_ptr + (c * NKC_B + offs_j) * M + m, mask=mask_j, other=0.0
+                    ),
+                    axis=0,
+                )
+                rs = tl.math.rsqrt(ssb / HS_ + eps)
+                k = c * HS_ + offs_q[:, None] * BKG + offs_k[None, :]
+                xr = tl.load(r_ptr + m * D + k, mask=mask_q[:, None], other=0.0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                wn = tl.load(wn_ptr + k, mask=mask_q[:, None], other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+                xn = ((xr * rs) * (1.0 + wn)).to(r_ptr.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+                wi = tl.load(wi_ptr + cp * D + k, mask=mask_q[:, None], other=0.0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                accv += xn * wi
+            g = tl.sum(tl.sum(accv, axis=1), axis=0)
+            tl.store(aout_ptr + m * HC_ + cp, 2.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g * (1.0 / HC_))))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_seam_up_kernel(
+    t_ptr,
+    rs_ptr,
+    r_ptr,
+    wn_ptr,
+    wu_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    M,
+    HC_: tl.constexpr,
+    HS_: tl.constexpr,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    BJ: tl.constexpr,
+    LA: tl.constexpr,
+    LB: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """A program owns BJ output columns: the W_up rows of all HC branches for them ([HC*BJ, L], loaded at once) go
+    through one dot pair with t ([BM, LA] + [BM, LB], LA + LB = L); the gated mean sums the branch axis."""
+    tl.static_assert(LA + LB == L)
+    D: tl.constexpr = HC_ * HS_
+    N: tl.constexpr = HC_ * BJ
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs_m = tl.program_id(1) * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    j = pid * BJ + tl.arange(0, BJ)
+    offs_c = tl.arange(0, HC_)
+    cols = tl.reshape(
+        offs_c[:, None] * HS_ + j[None, :], (N,)
+    )  # branch-major: [c0 j.., c1 j.., ...]
+    col_branch = tl.arange(0, N) // BJ
+    ra = tl.arange(0, LA)
+    rb = LA + tl.arange(0, LB)
+    t_a = tl.load(
+        t_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * L + ra[None, :], mask=mask_m[:, None], other=0.0
+    )
+    t_b = tl.load(
+        t_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * L + rb[None, :], mask=mask_m[:, None], other=0.0
+    )
+    wu_a = tl.load(wu_ptr + cols[:, None] * L + ra[None, :])
+    wu_b = tl.load(wu_ptr + cols[:, None] * L + rb[None, :])
+    xr = tl.load(
+        r_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * D + cols[None, :], mask=mask_m[:, None], other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    rs = tl.load(
+        rs_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * HC_ + col_branch[None, :],
+        mask=mask_m[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    wn = tl.load(wn_ptr + cols).to(tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.dot(t_a, tl.trans(wu_a))
+    acc = tl.dot(t_b, tl.trans(wu_b), acc)
+    xn = ((xr * rs) * (1.0 + wn)[None, :]).to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    prod = tl.reshape(tl.sigmoid(acc) * xn, (BM, HC_, BJ))
+    out = tl.sum(prod, axis=1) * (1.0 / HC_)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * HS_ + j[None, :],
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=mask_m[:, None],
+    )
+
+
+_workspaces: dict = {}
+
+
+def _workspace(device: torch.device):
+    # Sized for MAX_ROWS at the first call of any width, so no later call allocates it. SGLang's CUDA graph
+    # runners run each shape eagerly before capturing it, so that first call is not inside a capture.
+    ws = _workspaces.get(device)
+    if ws is None:
+        nkc = HC * HS // KA_KB
+        ws = dict(
+            p=torch.empty(
+                (nkc * MAX_ROWS * LOWRANK,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+            ),
+            ss=torch.empty((nkc * MAX_ROWS,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+            t=torch.empty((MAX_ROWS * LOWRANK,), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device),
+            rs=torch.empty((MAX_ROWS * HC,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+        )
+        _workspaces[device] = ws
+    return ws
+
+
+def hc_seam_supported(rows: int, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        0 < rows <= MAX_ROWS
+        and x.is_cuda
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and x.shape[1] == HC * HS
+        and x.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def hc_gated_combine(

+import pytest
+import torch

+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.hc_seam import (
+    HC,
+    HS,
+    LOWRANK,
+    hc_gated_combine,
+    hc_seam,
+)

+

+    not is_gfx95_supported(), reason="the HC seam runs on gfx950 only"
+)
+
+EPS = 1e-6
+D = HC * HS
+
+
+def _stage(gen):
+    def rnd(*shape, std):
+        return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen, device="cuda") * std).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+
+    return dict(
+        norm_w=rnd(D, std=0.1),
+        w_down=rnd(LOWRANK, D, std=0.04),
+        w_up=rnd(D, LOWRANK, std=0.1),
+        w_inject=rnd(HC, D, std=0.04),
+    )
+
+
+def _activations(gen, rows):
+    y = torch.randn(rows, HS, generator=gen, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    r = (torch.randn(rows, D, generator=gen, device="cuda") * 3.0).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    gate = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(torch.randn(rows, HC, generator=gen, device="cuda"))
+    return y, r, gate.contiguous()
+
+
+def _reference(y, residual, gate_prev, s):
+    """fp64 seam from the same bf16 inputs; R' and the gate's xn are rounded to bf16 as in the stock kernels."""
+    f = torch.float64
+    rows = residual.shape[0]
+    if y is not None:
+        a = gate_prev.to(f).repeat_interleave(HS, dim=1)
+        residual = (residual.to(f) + a * y.to(f).repeat(1, HC)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    x = residual.to(f).view(rows, HC, HS)
+    rs = torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    xn = (x * rs * (1.0 + s["norm_w"].to(f).view(HC, HS))).view(rows, D)
+    d = xn @ s["w_down"].to(f).t() / HC
+    g = torch.sigmoid((d * torch.sigmoid(d)) @ s["w_up"].to(f).t()).view(rows, HC, HS)

+    gate = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(
+        xn.to(torch.bfloat16).to(f) @ s["w_inject"].to(f).t() / HC
+    )
+    return residual, mixed, gate
+
+

+    a, b = a.double(), b.double()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+

+    cfg = HyperConnectionConfig(
